amendments.cause: DEV-CAL-1 (PR #328) landed D30_receipts.jsonl and DEVCAL1_receipts_shard{1..4}.jsonl after this freeze bound RECEIPT_COVERAGE_V1.json, so the committed table no longer derived from the receipts (COVERAGE_DRIFT 20 on first re-run). Re-emitted the table (15 files x 13 families) and extended derive_receipt_coverage.py with the ZERO_FAMILY_RECEIPT finding class so the five receipts emitting no frozen family (D22 + all four DEVCAL1 shards) are DECLARED rather than silently absent. The (empty) amendment_chain field predates this amendment and is retained verbatim; this freeze's amendments live under 'amendments', the key verify_freeze_chain.py resolves.

D31 episodic depth law (#323 economy-frontier lane) landed exact/receipts/D31_receipts.jsonl after AM-1 bound RECEIPT_COVERAGE_V1.json, so the committed table again diverged from the receipts (COVERAGE_DRIFT 20 on re-run). amendments.cause: Issue #165 s16 / P1_PIPELINE_FREEZE_V1.json built the independent-authorship pipeline in research/independent-authorship-gate-v1: three transcribed IPC STRIPS domains (ipc_domains/: blocksworld IPC-2, gripper IPC-1, logistics IPC-1, per-file provenance headers), the independent plan validator p1_validator.py (stdlib-only, zero src/ocm imports), the family emitter p1_families.py, and the emitted P1_FAMILY_TABLE_V1.json (3 families, 13 members, deterministic under the frozen seed; p1_selftest.py four hostiles + no-alarm green, distinct exit codes). This amendment supersedes ON RECORD the E3_PROTOCOL_FREEZE_V1 P1 status line 'authorship pipeline not yet built' WITHOUT editing that frozen file, and binds the pipeline shas so any later modification requires a further amendment per this freeze's rule. Keys are paths relative to this freeze's directory because verify_freeze_chain.py resolves manifest keys against its own directory. Nothing recorded in this directory is superseded (prior_manifest_sha256_observed empty by construction).

cause: D28 F1 (MEDIUM): no freeze manifest named any exact/results/*.json, so post-landing edits to landed results were invisible to the chain (two real disclosed instances: 905a7200, 97b38de2). F9 showed the same hole for emitters (an oracle default flip would have been chain-enforced had emitters been hash-bound). This freeze binds every evidence artifact, receipt, and emitter of the lane as of creation.
rule: append-only amendments; the newest amendment naming a file is authoritative; a change without an amendment is UNRECORDED_DRIFT and fails CI (freeze-chain.yml)
scope: exact/results/*, exact/receipts/*, exact/*.py (emitters+worlds+runners), RECEIPT_COVERAGE_V1.json, derive_receipt_coverage.py. New studies ADD files freely (unbound until named); MODIFying any bound file requires an amendment below naming the file and its new sha256, per verify_freeze_chain.py resolution rules.
